purpose: Collects a one-time code for sign-in or verification as a row of single-character slots over one real input. Paste fills every slot at once.

notFor.case: A password or any value that is not a short one-time code.

Empty.visual: Every slot in its Default look; separator in Content/subtle.

Typing.meaning: Part of the code is entered.
Typing.visual: Entered slots Filled, the next slot Typing with the caret and a Border/focus edge and Border/ring/default halo, the rest Default.

Invalid.visual: Every slot takes a Status/critical/border-strong edge, with no halo.

Disabled.visual: Every slot Disabled; separator in Content/disabled.

a11y.role: one textbox (input-otp OTPInput) with autocomplete="one-time-code"; the slots are presentational
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the one input. Characters fill the next slot, Backspace clears the previous one, Arrow Left and Right move between slots, paste fills every slot.
notes: Give it a label (Field, or aria-label); on Invalid expose the error through aria-describedby.
Set length to the code's length.

openQuestions: Invalid: Figma draws no halo on an invalid slot, unlike Input and Textarea. Is that intended, or should Invalid gain Status/critical/border?
Auto-submit: should a Filled code submit itself, or always wait for a Button?
